newsitem.title: USA: Thermo Sentron buys Australian company.
newsitem.headline: Thermo Sentron buys Australian company.

text.p: Thermo Sentron Inc said Tuesday it acquired the assets of RCC Industrial Electronics Pty Ltd of Sydney, Australia, for about $1 million and the assumption of certain liabilities.
RCC Industrial makes in-motion checkweighers for the food and pharmaceutical industries, posting annual revenues of $1.4 million, Thermo Sentron said.

The deal will give Thermo Sentron, a publicly traded unit of Thermedics Inc, a base for expansion of its packaged-goods business in the food and pharmaceuticals markets in Australia and Southeast Asia.
Thermo Sentron shares were down 1/4 Tuesday at 10-3/8.
